logline: A space-station janitor finds a glowing key and pockets it.
style: cinematic photoreal, 35mm anamorphic, teal-orange grade, soft volumetric light

bible.style: cinematic photoreal, 35mm anamorphic, teal-orange grade, soft volumetric light

characters.name: Marlow
characters.face: tired hazel eyes, two-week stubble, faint scar across left brow
characters.wardrobe: stained gray jumpsuit, name patch reads MARLOW, scuffed work boots
props: a battered keyring on his belt
characters.anchor_pose: neutral half-body portrait, soft three-quarter lighting, looking slightly off-camera
characters.anchor_setting: industrial corridor with flickering fluorescent light

shots.action: Marlow pushes a mop bucket down a flickering corridor.
Marlow stops, frowns at something on the floor just out of frame.
A small key glows faint blue in a puddle of mop water.
Marlow kneels, glove hovers above the glowing key.
Marlow pockets the key, stands, scans the corridor both ways, picks up the mop and keeps walking.
